Container.Name: DockRoute
Container.Overview:
External-DNS for plain Docker hosts: DockRoute watches your running containers, reads dockroute.* labels and reconciles the matching DNS records - and Cloudflare Tunnel routes - in a pluggable provider.
Your Docker labels are the source of truth; DockRoute makes the provider match them, and never alters records it cannot prove it manages (ExternalDNS-style TXT ownership).
Opt a container in with labels: dockroute.enabled=true and dockroute.hostname=app.example.com. Start with the default 'log' provider for a zero-credential dry run, then switch to 'cloudflare'.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Docker Engine socket (read-only). DockRoute only listens to events and lists containers.

Config.Name: Provider
Config.Description: DNS provider: 'log' (dry run, prints desired state, no credentials needed) or 'cloudflare'.

Config.Name: Owner ID
Config.Description: Ownership id written to companion TXT records; lets several DockRoute instances share a zone safely.

Config.Name: Sync policy
Config.Description: sync = create/update/delete owned records; upsert-only = never delete; create-only = never update or delete.

Config.Name: Default target
Config.Description: Fallback record value (IP or CNAME target) when a container omits the dockroute.target label. E.g. your server's LAN or WAN IP.

Config.Name: Domain filter
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of DNS zones DockRoute may touch. Empty = all zones the token can see.

Config.Name: Resync interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Interval of the periodic full reconcile that backs up the event stream.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API token
Config.Description: Required when provider is cloudflare. Needs Zone > DNS > Edit (+ Account > Cloudflare Tunnel > Edit for tunnel publishing).

Config.Name: Cloudflare account ID
Config.Description: Only needed for Cloudflare Tunnel publishing.

Config.Name: Cloudflare tunnel ID
Config.Description: Only needed for Cloudflare Tunnel publishing. Uses an existing tunnel - you keep running cloudflared yourself.
